page.overview:
Who is Desmond Mercer?

Desmond Mercer was a representative of House Hurata in the Landsraad.

Desmond Mercer was approached by the Prisoner on a cliff to the north of Imperial Testing Station No. 10 in the Eastern Vermillius Gap.
